notes.text: The notice says Rav Sheshet said and gives נדה לא: (Niddah 31b by the colon convention). The bracketed He reported supplies the contextual entry subject. No saying or verified modern passage is supplied; the older note's locator observation does not exhaust the body, which also names Rav Sheshet.
